SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.description, t.sort_order, t.create_time, t.update_time, COUNT(DISTINCT at.article_id) AS article_count FROM t_tag t LEFT JOIN t_article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id LEFT JOIN t_article a ON at.article_id = a.id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, t.create_time DESC
